free wifi

 

 Magnificent 2 bedroom, 2 bathrooms duplex apartment, located on the 6th floor in Block A, of the Skol building in Marbella. This bright, East-facing apartment has great sea views. The popular Skol Complex is a front-line beach right in the heart of Marbella, and 50 meters away from the famous Marbella port. Surrounded by fine dining restaurants and also pubs, bars, and shops.

 This newly-renovated duplex comprises: on the bottom floor, spacious living/dining room with flat-screen TV, sofa-bed, and access to the furnished terrace; fully-fitted kitchen with dishwasher, washing machine, electric hob, and microwave; and separate bathroom with shower; stairs to the bedroom area; master bedroom with twin beds and large windows with superb views; second interior bedroom with twin beds; and separate bathroom with shower. The apartment is equipped with A/C throughout and its own Wi-Fi connection.

 This high-quality apartment offers some of the best accommodation in Marbella.

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ Private A/C in the bedrooms and the living room.

 🏊‍ Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 🔑 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 ☕ Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!

 🚗 If you want a parking space, once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive information about the parking closest to the Skol Building, which you may reserve online through an external company (price and availability on their website).
